API: check_point_board(*, commands, height, input_epoch, packet, tick)
algorithm: Copy private word through exact builtin JSON trees; reject float/custom structures; check exact six command field sets and strict-prior integer source refs. No primitive rule is logically accepted by this structural check.

Independently construct each absolute row: leading copies of original first zero-port primitive, then entire original word with all source indices shifted by height-minus-length. Do not call/import converter or a point engine.

From each padded row reconstruct exact primitive witness, ordered input formulas/offsets, canonical complete prototype preimage/ID, local t/m, translated t/m and fixed boundary. Tagged formula values carry full canonical formula strings, not only hashes.

Compare every packet field/list/order/scalar recursively with exact builtin type identity before equality. Boolean coordinates/indices/weights cannot pass as integers; extra/missing/reordered data and changed flags reject.

Reaccumulate actual compared positive support and all fixed/active markings. All support must lie in declared target, each required point totals exactly1, duplicate marks agree literally, agreeing repeated ports contribute repeated mark occurrences. One selected placement per row; identical type ID must retain identical complete preimage.

Return whole exact-board receipt plus newly rebuilt padded command list for separate bounded membership and1717 logical verification. Mandatory tick exceptions propagate; there is no clock/reset/Source import/process/plan/output-file behavior.
external_mandatory_gates: Whole original source word must be bound to private original theory/Gamma/target and current language epoch; the packet itself supplies none of that authority.

Verify every padded command belongs to exact selected bounded language and check whole padded word with unchanged independent1717 endpoint against original private target/theory/parameters/Gamma. Converter/checker may preserve a structurally valid but logically invalid word; this point receipt never accepts it as a theorem.

Genuine cold caller must authenticate/load/seal exact Source/callback/native/argument authority and complete output raw/EOF, without using producer-mutated authority objects. All setup/copy/reconstruction/logical checks/output/exit costs remain original20/512/55/60/caller90+1.

Positive finite board requires no complete candidate cardinality or search trajectory. Complete implicit inventory/counts/globaldead-forced-earliestgeneration/rollback need separate conformance before any GCTS search claim.

Meaningful later controls: changed target/boundary, bool scalar, missing/duplicate row, stale epoch/preimage, wrong source/offset/input label, malformed packet, conflicting duplicate marks, and padded membership/word mismatch. None were executed during authoring.

point_model.boundary: Outside sentinel at channel1 rows1-H..-1; exact original private-word final formula at channel1 rowH-1. Entire expected boundary is reconstructed and compared.
point_model.domain: integer pairs; exact unit t, full tagged literal m
point_model.identity: Prototype preimage = private input epoch + primitive witness + ordered premise formulas + ordered strictly negative offsets; placement = type ID and translation. Complete preimages are retained and duplicate ID/preimage disagreement rejects.

private_inputs: Caller-authenticated original full nonempty word, exact height1..24, lowercase64hex input epoch. Never take private authority from packet. Actual profile first endpoint uses height24; this API does not change it. The whole original final target/theory/Gamma/profile remain caller-private external authority.
scope: Exact positive point-board projection only; no generated proof route, selected GCTS search, adjacency-only Wang palette, learned marking, family, RL or advantage.
